_doc: Manual cluster overrides applied by analysis/series_clustering.assign_series_ids. force_same_cluster bonds the listed [a, b] MAL ID pairs even if rule classification leaves them apart. force_separate_cluster splits the pair even if rule classification would unite them; SEPARATE always wins over SAME for the same pair. Populated reactively when Phase D / production results surface a real mis-cluster. 2026-06-04: 42 pairs added from an audit of 'Other'-relation cross-cluster anime-anime pairs in series_relations_cache.jsonl. Covers MAL-labeled-'Other' recap/PV/short-spinoff content that the PR #77 ruleset correctly skips (Other is too ambiguous as a category) but that legitimately belongs in the main-franchise cluster. Excluded by deliberate choice: 12 Yu-Gi-Oh distinct-continuity pairs (Arc-V/VRAINS/Sevens/Go Rush/Zexal/5D's/GX cross-links — same brand, distinct continuities like FMA case); 2 Aikatsu distinct-continuity pairs (Friends/Planet/on Parade umbrella); 1 PriPara/Pri☆chan crossover (cross-franchise movie); 1 Gundam Evolve (covers multiple Gundam metaverses); 1 One Room ↔ Room Mate (same studio, narratively distinct); 3 He Wei Dao Chinese-liquor crossover ads (insufficient signal). 2026-09-20: 4 force_separate_cluster pairs added for Gundam metaverse splits. [90, 3288] + [93, 3288] cut Gundam Evolve's Side Story edges to Wing (After Colony) and SEED (Cosmic Era) — Evolve is a genuine multi-metaverse anthology OVA whose Side Story edges were transitively merging Wing + SEED via Pass 1 union. Post-fix, Evolve becomes its own singleton cluster (accurate for a multi-metaverse anthology; its only other in-vault edges are Parent Story which is SOFT). [89, 95] + [89, 23259] cut Victory Gundam's factually-wrong MAL 'Sequel' labels to ∀ Gundam (Correct Century) and Reconguista in G (Regild Century) — three distinct metaverses that MAL merged via bad Sequel classification. Not fixed here (deliberate scope decision): a full-vault audit for other MAL Sequel mislabelings would need anime-canon ground truth beyond Gundam; the remaining 26 Gundam clusters verified clean at 2026-09-20.
